observation.command: cd /tmp && docker compose -f /workspace/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres pg_dump -U yii2_user yii2_db > /tmp/backup_validation.sql 2>/tmp/backup_err.txt; echo "pg_dump exit=$?" && wc -l /tmp/backup_validation.sql && head -5 /tmp/backup_validation.sql && grep -c 'backendusers' /tmp/backup_validation.sql && cat /tmp/backup_err.txt
